The '''Battle of Saloch''' was a battle of the [[Reslian Purge]] that took place on [[Saloch²]] in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]].

The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and particularly the [[6/37th|sixth]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing]] saved the [[Tunroth]] from extermination and defeated the [[Lortan]] fanatics.

This battle was the first battle of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].
